top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Decline, Fed Keeps Rates Steady: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stock futures fell in early Asian trading as investors weighed mixed earnings from megacap technology companies and the Federal Reserve held rates steady without signaling whether a December hike is likely.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Takaichi and Merz pledge to boost economic security and tech cooperation
top_signals.summary: The leaders expressed "grave concern" over economic coercion, including arbitrary export restrictions and retaliatory measures on critical minerals.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
